title: Base change compatibility of the direct-image counit
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme over $\operatorname{Spec}(k)$, and let $\sigma:\operatorname{Spec}(k)\to X$ be a rational point with its structure-map compatibility. For every $T\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ assume the base-changed module category has injective resolutions. Let $T'\to T$ be a morphism and let $\mathcal L$ be an object of the normalized Picard subfunctor with invertible direct image [def-pc-picard-functor] [def-pc-pic-sigma-functor]. Then the pullback along the induced base-change map of the adjunction counit $f_T^*f_{T,*}\mathcal L\to\mathcal L$ is isomorphic as an arrow to the counit for the pulled-back object over $T'$. [def-pc-scheme].
